{{Quote|Many of the worlds that we service, our neighbors, have already seceded. It is most prudent for us to continue serving them as best as possible. Furthermore, removed from the burden of Republic tariffs and bureaucracy, we will actually see a rise in efficiency and, eventually, profits for our farmers.|Overliege Topas dosLa|<ref name="hnn" />}}
'''Topas dosLa''' was an individual who served as the [[Overliege]] for the [[Ukian government|government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_1.html|Abrion Sector Secedes; Separatists Get Agri-Worlds}} is set on the date 13:4:148 which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The Overliege and the other leaders of [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]s located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] announced that they would [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secede]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and join the fledgling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As part of the announcement, Overliege dosLa explained that their decision was primarily due to the fact that many of the worlds that Ukio serviced had already seceded, and the Overliege felt it was prudent for Ukio itself to continue providing those services. In addition, dosLa stated that the decision would also free Ukio of Republic tariffs and that they were confident that Ukio would enjoy new levels of profitability for his [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], as well as an increase in efficiency. The same [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report that covered the announcement included part of dosLa's statement. The secession of the Abrion sector inspired debate within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as to whether or not they should approve subsidy packages for any [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplication worlds still within the Republic.<ref name="hnn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Topas dosLa was mentioned in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52]]'', an article<ref name="hnn" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Master">'{{InsiderCite|91|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> and published in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52]]'' on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="hnn" /> on [[April 18]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN52 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6493893|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-04-18|time=6:27 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref>
